structArrays.name: statusBar
structArrays.meaning: top status bar ("Score  Kills  Level  Ganja Farmer", REGBAR.PNG)

structArrays.name: gunSight
structArrays.meaning: mouse-driven aiming cursor (crosshair); x = mouseX/2 - 16, y = mouseY; also the menu pointer. curr_frame (0x33c0c) = 1 in menus, 0 in game; visible (0x33c2c)

structArrays.name: van
structArrays.meaning: John's 1969 VW microbus (static, drawn under the rasta)

structArrays.name: rasta
structArrays.meaning: John Parker, the player (rasta with the gun on the van roof). curr_frame (0x33f24) = aim direction / weapon pose; state (0x33f2c): 1 aiming, 0x2b/0x2c idle joint-smoking animation, 0x3a/0x3b bong loading
structArrays.source: rasta.pcx (40 frames, 4 rows: one row per weapon)

structArrays.name: choppers
structArrays.meaning: enemy helicopters; drop paratroopers. counter_1 (+0x10) = x velocity, counter_2 (+0x14) = hit points (10), counter_3 (+0x18) = crash timer, state 0x1c/0x1b = flying right/left, 0x1a = crashing, 0 = respawn

structArrays.name: explosions
structArrays.meaning: explosion animations (ring buffer, next slot = explosionNext 0x60b8c); state 0x26 = pending, 1 = animating, 0 = idle

structArrays.name: paratroopers
structArrays.meaning: paratroopers descending under a parachute (dropped by choppers). state 0x1c/0x1b swinging down, 0x27 landing, 0x28 landed -> becomes a groundTroops entry, 0x21 chute shot (free fall, counter_2 = fall speed), 2/3/4 shot dying; 0 unused
structArrays.source: ptroop.pcx (frames cut into entry 0, frame pointers copied to entries 1..24)

structArrays.name: groundTroops
structArrays.meaning: landed paratroopers walking on the ground toward the herb (state 0x2f walk, 0x30 attacking a plant -> plant state 0x32, 0x2e/0x31 walking away); counter_3 (+0x18) = walk direction (1 right, 0 left)

fieldUse.0x10: counter_1 (written, see ORIGINAL BUG note in 136a5)

structArrays.name: plants
structArrays.meaning: the herb (ganja plants) row at y=0x96, x = i*12. state 1 = growing, 0x32 = charge planted by a ground trooper (counter_2 fuse), 0x29 = burning (counter_1 = 180), 0x33 = regrowing (counter_3 timer, set by Jah / the "420" cheat), 0 = dead (frame 5) or abducted (frame 7). Game over when all states are 0

structArrays.name: a10Jets
structArrays.meaning: A-10 jet that crosses the sky dropping bombs; threshold_1 (+0x1c) = hit points (4), counter_1 = x velocity, counter_2 = entered-screen flag, counter_3 = bomb drop delay, state 1 flying / 0x2a bombing run

structArrays.name: bombs
structArrays.meaning: bombs dropped by the A-10 (next slot = bombNext 0x60b9c); state 1 falling (counter_1 = vx, counter_2 = vy), explode at y >= 0xa0 burning plants; shooting one scores 501

structArrays.name: cropDusters
structArrays.meaning: crop-duster planes that spray herbicide on the plants; counter_1 = x velocity, counter_2 = hit points (4), counter_3 = spray duration, state 1 flying / 0x2d spraying

structArrays.name: messageBox
structArrays.meaning: dialog box; curr_frame (0x3de78): 0 "Level Done Mon", 1 "Praise Jah!!! more herb", 2 "GAME OVER", 3 "Jah say: Fight the power mon!" (RGDIABOX.PNG)

structArrays.name: dusterSpray
structArrays.meaning: herbicide spray droplets emitted by the crop dusters (ring, next slot = sprayNext 0x60bac); a droplet reaching the plant row kills a plant

structArrays.name: scoreDigits
structArrays.meaning: 7 digit sprites showing score (0x60a68) in the status bar / high-score table; curr_frame = digit

structArrays.name: killsDigits
structArrays.meaning: digit sprites showing kills (0x60a6c); 5 initialised, only 4 used

structArrays.name: levelDigits
structArrays.meaning: 3 digit sprites showing the level (0x30bec)

structArrays.name: volumeSliders
structArrays.meaning: sound-menu slider knobs: [0] F/X volume (0x45744 -> dws_XDig), [1] music volume (0x458d0 -> dws_XMusic), [2] master volume (0x45a5c -> dws_XMaster). Separate Sprite_Init calls but contiguous

structArrays.name: soundMenu
structArrays.meaning: sound options panel; curr_frame (0x45d50) shows the music-samples checkbox (= musicSamplesEnabled == 0)

structArrays.name: jah
structArrays.meaning: Jah on a cloud: bounces on the high-score screen; in game flies across every 5 levels dropping a powerup (state 0x1c/0x1b, 0x20 idle, threshold_3 0x45d98 = drop pass state 0x41/0x42/0x43); at level end descends and replants the herb (counter_2 0x45d88 = replant time = level*10 frames). threshold_1/2 = dx/dy on the high-score screen

structArrays.name: missile
structArrays.meaning: homing rocket fired by the missile-launcher weapon (0x35); 5 direction frames; threshold_3 (0x45f24) = lifetime; state (0x46070) 1 = flying

structArrays.name: missileTarget
structArrays.meaning: "DIE MON" lock-on marker placed at the gunsight when a missile is fired; follows the locked enemy (counter_2/counter_3 = dx/dy copied from the target)

structArrays.name: missileSmoke
structArrays.meaning: smoke-trail puffs left by the missile (ring, next slot = missileSmokeNext 0x60eec); counter_1 = lifetime

structArrays.name: ufo
structArrays.meaning: UFO that abducts a plant with a beam (target plant index 0x60bd0); threshold_2 (0x4c3ac) = hit points, counter_2 = vx, counter_3 = beam timer; 1000 points

structArrays.name: bongSmoke
structArrays.meaning: smoke clouds shot by the bong weapon (0x38): counter_1/counter_2 = velocity, state 1 = flying; hit enemies

structArrays.name: powerupDrop
structArrays.meaning: weapon / bonus crate on a parachute dropped by Jah; curr_frame (0x5fbe0) = kind: 0 auto gun, 1 missile launcher, 2 bong, 3 +42000 points; state (0x5fbe8) 1 = falling

structArrays.name: cruiseMissile
structArrays.meaning: cruise missile carrying a nuke; state 0x46/0x45 flying right/left, 0x44 detonated (threshold_1 0x5fc20 = flash countdown, burns every plant); appears from level 25 (sub_159e7)

structArrays.name: nukeCloud
structArrays.meaning: mushroom cloud shown when the cruise missile detonates; state (0x5ff00) 1 = visible

tables.name: bullets

fields.name: savedPixel
fields.type: int32 (colour under the tracer pixel, Read_Pixel_DB; restored with Write_Pixel_DB)

fields.name: xStepTenths
fields.type: int32 (fractional part of vx in tenths)

fields.name: xStepCounter
fields.type: int32 (reloaded from +0x10 every 10 frames, adds 1px while >= 0)

tables.meaning: machine-gun tracer bullets (single pixels) fired by the gun weapons (0x36/0x37) from the rasta toward the gunsight; each shot costs 1 point; hits damage choppers, bombs, A-10, dusters, cruise missile, UFO and paratroopers. sub_11c2a spawns (loops 59), sub_12130 moves/collides (60)

tables.name: highScores
tables.meaning: high-score table, read from / written to scores.dat

tables.name: explosionDelays

fields.name: delay
fields.type: int32 (per explosions[] slot; incremented every frame, the explosion starts animating when > 0x32; set to 0x33 = start now, 0x30..0x36 staggered, 0xc = delayed)

tables.meaning: start delay counters of the 13 explosions slots

tables.name: paletteFade
tables.meaning: per-DAC-entry fade-in state used by the logo screen fade (sub_102d1); entries 1..254 used, step = component / 20.0

tables.name: cycleColors
tables.meaning: the 4 colours rotated through DAC entries 0xf9..0xfc by sub_14fba (red 3f/0/0, yellow 3f/3d/0, green 1/3c/0, grey 9/9/9: rasta colours)

tables.name: highScoreRowColors

fields.name: color
fields.type: int32 palette index (0xf9..0xfc, the cycling colours)

tables.meaning: text colour of each high-score row (copied to a local array and passed to Print_String_DB)
tables.evidence: src/game/107ce_sub_107ce.js:29; src/game/107ce_sub_107ce.js:61; flat.bin 0x30c24 = f9 fa fb fc f9 fa fb fc f9 fa

tables.name: chopperSoundStatus

fields.name: status
fields.type: uint16 (dws_DSoundStatus result for sndChopper, per chopper)

tables.meaning: dws_DSoundStatus result words, one per chopper; chopper.dwd is replayed when 0 and the chopper is near the screen

globals.name: score
globals.meaning: player score (7 digits in the status bar, saved in highScores); +kill points, -1 per bullet

globals.name: kills
globals.meaning: enemies killed (status bar "Kills", 4 digits)

globals.name: level
globals.meaning: current level (status bar "Level", saved with the high score, drives enemy selection in sub_159e7/sub_16446); starts at 1, +1 when a level ends

globals.name: levelTimer
globals.meaning: frames left in the current level (0x438 at start); below 0 -> levelEnding = 1; below -0x21c all enemies are cleared

globals.name: levelEnding
globals.meaning: set when levelTimer runs out: no new enemies spawn; when all enemies are gone the level-complete sequence runs and level++

globals.name: gameState
globals.meaning: program/menu state: 0x22 = start game (menu "play" button), 0x1c = back to menu (game over or quit confirmed), 0x25 = exit program; initial 1

globals.name: allHerbDead
globals.meaning: 1 when every plant state is 0 (computed each frame) -> game over

globals.name: levelEndLoopState
globals.meaning: loop control of the level-complete sequence (sub_15e15): 0x22 running, set to 0x1c by sub_16837 when Jah has flown away

globals.name: inLevelEndSequence
globals.meaning: 1 while the level-complete sequence runs (suppresses the rasta idle reset in sub_18f27)

globals.name: jahReplantX
globals.meaning: x of the first plant of the longest run of dead plants (-1 if none): where Jah flies to replant at level end

globals.name: frameStartTime
globals.meaning: Timer_Query() at the start of a frame; frame pacing waits until the BIOS tick advances

globals.name: mouseX
globals.meaning: mouse x from Squeeze_Mouse(3) (0..639; gunsight x = mouseX/2 - 16)

globals.name: mouseY
globals.meaning: mouse y from Squeeze_Mouse(3)

globals.name: mouseButtons
globals.meaning: mouse buttons from Squeeze_Mouse(3): 1 = left (fire / menu click), 2 = right (switch weapon)

globals.name: prevGunSightX
globals.meaning: gunsight x of the previous frame (idle detection)

globals.name: prevGunSightY
globals.meaning: gunsight y of the previous frame

globals.name: frameCounter10
globals.meaning: frame counter cycling 0..10; bullets reload their sub-pixel step counters when >= 10

globals.name: currentWeapon
globals.meaning: selected weapon: 0x36 default gun (semi-auto), 0x37 automatic gun, 0x35 missile launcher, 0x38 bong; right click cycles among owned ones

globals.name: hasAutoGun
globals.meaning: automatic gun (weapon 0x37) collected (powerup kind 0 / cheat G+N)

globals.name: hasMissileLauncher
globals.meaning: missile launcher (weapon 0x35) collected

globals.name: hasBong
globals.meaning: bong weapon (0x38) collected

globals.name: rightButtonHeld
globals.meaning: latch so one right click switches weapon only once

globals.name: fireReady
globals.meaning: gate for firing with the left button: default gun requires release between shots, the other weapons alternate every frame

globals.name: bongState
globals.meaning: bong weapon phase: 0x39 = needs (re)loading (rasta plays bong animation), 0x3c = loaded and firing

globals.name: bongShotsLeft
globals.meaning: frames of bong smoke left before reloading (0x3c)

globals.name: bongBlowPending
globals.meaning: play sndBongBlow on the next bong shot

globals.name: bongHitTimer
globals.meaning: countdown (0x5a) of the bong-hit pose (rasta state 0x3b)

globals.name: idleTimer
globals.meaning: frames without mouse movement/click before the rasta starts smoking (100)

globals.name: smokeGlowPhase
globals.meaning: phase of the idle smoking animation: 2 = joint glow brightening (DAC 0xb6), 0 = frames advancing, 1 = frames returning

globals.name: rastaAnimDelay
globals.meaning: frame-delay counter of the rasta smoking / bong animations (advance every 5 frames)

globals.name: jointGlowColor
globals.meaning: colour written to DAC entry 0xb6 during the idle smoking animation (red channel ramps up)

globals.name: randomVoice

notes:
Coverage: every inventory address is either a named global, inside a named struct/table (field of an element), a string literal, or listed here.
Layout: the sprite structs are one contiguous block 0x33918..0x5ff1c (statusBar, gunSight, van, rasta, choppers[5], (gap 0x345c4..0x34704 unused by game code), explosions[13], paratroopers[25], groundTroops[25], plants[26], a10Jets[1], bombs[4], cropDusters[3], messageBox, dusterSpray[63], scoreDigits[7], killsDigits[5], levelDigits[3], volumeSliders[3], soundMenu, jah, missile, missileTarget, missileSmoke[63], ufo, bongSmoke[200], powerupDrop, cruiseMissile, nukeCloud), followed by bullets[60] 0x5ff20, frameStartTime, score, kills, highScores[9], mouseX/Y/buttons, ... The pcx_pictures pcxScratch + 5 menu frames are consecutive at stride 0x398 (0x31ee4..0x33474) but are used as separate objects.
Struct-array element vs true array: choppers/paratroopers/groundTroops/plants/bombs/cropDusters/explosions/dusterSpray/missileSmoke/bongSmoke/score-kills-levelDigits are true arrays indexed in loops; volumeSliders are 3 separately initialised objects (fx, music, master) that happen to be contiguous; a10Jets is an array of 1 (all loops have bound 1). keyboardState, explosionDelays, chopperSoundStatus, highScoreRowColors are true arrays.
ORIGINAL BUG (known): sub_12e85 reads paratroopers[25].state = groundTroops[0].state (0x3833c) when paratrooperNext==24.
Weapons (currentWeapon 0x60ee8): 0x36 default gun (semi-auto, bullets, sndGunShot), 0x37 automatic gun (hasAutoGun, pickup voice sndAutomatic), 0x35 missile launcher (hasMissileLauncher, fires missile+missileTarget, pickup voice sndRastaRocket), 0x38 bong (hasBong, fires bongSmoke, pickup voice sndBongDeath). Weapon names are inferred from DRPSHOOT/RASTA/MISSLE sprite sheets and sound names (medium confidence for the exact wording; roles are high).
Kill points: chopper crash 101, bomb 501, A-10 300, duster 100, UFO 1000, paratrooper chute 15, body 11, landed trooper squashed 100, Jah replant bonus 8000, powerup +42000, idle smoke +1000, cheat F3+F4 +5000; each bullet -1.
Keyboard (keyboardState index = scancode): Esc quit prompt (Y/N), P pause, F2 sound menu, Space/Enter continue. Cheats: F3+F4 +5000; L+V+U level+1; L+V+D level-1; N+U+K clear all enemies (sub_1a825); 4+2+0 ("420") regrow all plants + sndYaMon; G+N auto gun, G+M missile launcher, G+B bong; J + arrow keys move Jah; debug level select keys 3,5..9 -> level 3,5..9 and A -> level 14 (chunk_1d630.js:40-66).
Plant/enemy state values are the game's own codes (e.g. 0x1b/0x1c direction, 0x26 explosion pending); described in each entry, no names claimed for the numeric codes.
Not named (left out): 0x3000c/0x30019/0x30026 fopen mode strings "w"/"r"/"r"; double constants 0x3014c=5.0, 0x30154=-5.0, 0x3015c=0.1, 0x30164=-5.0, 0x3016c=0.1 (bullet speed), 0x30184=7.0, 0x3018c=-7.0, 0x30194=-7.0 (bong smoke speed); 0x61669 = jointGlowColor.g (byte +1 of the RGB_color at 0x61668); 0x64e78..0x64e7a = 3 bytes (BSS, just before doubleBuffer) copied as the initialiser of a local RGB_color in sub_18a58 and immediately overwritten -> probably a compiler-emitted zero initialiser, no meaning.
Load_File buffers 0x60f20..0x60fec: the raw pointers returned by Load_File, each copied once into the .snd/.track field of its STK struct; named <struct>Data.
Most uncertain: smokeGlowPhase, fireReady, bongState/bongShotsLeft/bongBlowPending, bongHitTimer, frameCounter10, inLevelEndSequence, musicSamplesEnabled, sndPdie4 (pdie4.dwd used only for the idle-smoke bonus), sndLogo, resetHighScores.
